method: Shared dated locality/point observations in overlapping rectangular regions; connections with named origin points count at that origin, while route-only and focused topic records are excluded. Intersecting source windows count, not historical-memory display. Counts are evidence records, not towns, populations, continuous occupancy or research effort. Empty cells are not classified as human absence. Undated records remain separate.

detailed.region: Fiji / Tonga / Samoa east of dateline
